spans.s: ख—चमस m. ‘the drinking-vessel in the sky’, N. of the moon, L.
ख—चर mfn. moving in the air, flying, MBh.; R.; BhP.
an aerial spirit, Vidyādhara, Kathās. cx, 139
(in music) a kind of Rūpaka or measure, L.
ख—चर m. pl. N. of a fabulous people, VarBṛS.
ख—चर—त्व n. the state of a Rakṣas or demon, HYog.
ख—चारिन् mfn. moving in the air, flying (said of Skanda), MBh. iii, 14635
ख—चित्र n. ‘a picture in the sky’, anything impossible or not existing, Kathās. il, 142.
(ifc. or with instr.) inlaid, set, studded (e.g. मणि-ख्˚, inlaid with jewels), MBh. vii
xiii; Hariv.; Megh. &c. (= करम्बित, ‘combined with’, L.)
